intuition: For a query point, choose a stored point sharing its x-coordinate; the other two corners are fixed by the vertical side length.

brute_force.approach: Enumerate all point triples and test whether they form an axis-aligned square with the query.

optimal.approach: Count duplicate coordinates and enumerate same-x points, multiplying the multiplicities of the three required corners.

edge_cases: Duplicate points increase the number of distinct point selections.
A square requires a nonzero vertical side and either horizontal direction.
